CleanFrame Brings Minimalist Art Mode Launcher to Android TV

04 Nov 2026, 09:29 AM IST · GlobeWire Daily Editorial Desk · Source: github.com

2 min read

Key takeawaysA new open-source project named CleanFrame has been released for Android TV and Google TV devices, offering a minimalist, distraction-free home launcher experience inspired by Samsung The Frame's Art Mode screensaver.

Image: GitHub · Photo source · Resized and letterboxed to 16:9; no AI generation

In this article
  1. Key Features and Capabilities
  2. Practical Implications and Verification

A new open-source project named CleanFrame has been released for Android TV and Google TV devices, offering a minimalist, distraction-free home launcher experience inspired by Samsung The Frame's Art Mode screensaver.

Ported from an original project built for Samsung's Tizen platform, CleanFrame aims to bring a serene aesthetic and high-resolution photographic gallery to Android TV hardware such as Xiaomi, Sony, Nvidia Shield, and Chromecast devices.

Key Features and Capabilities

  • Full-Screen Art Mode: Turns the display into a zero-UI photographic art canvas. Users can browse bundled offline artworks using the TV remote or rely on an auto-slideshow and idle timer.
  • Quick Network Settings: Features a dedicated status icon for fast Wi-Fi and Ethernet configuration, automatically detecting the active connection type.
  • Universal Display Scaling: Built with devicePixelRatio compensation to fit 720p, 1080p, and 4K UHD displays cleanly without cropping.
  • External Input Integration: Integrates with Android's TvInputManager to support switching to connected devices like consoles or cable boxes.
  • Smart Play Store Redirection: Automatically directs uninstalled streaming apps to their official Google Play Store installation page instead of throwing errors.
  • Leanback Integration: Fully integrates with native Android TV navigation standards using standard D-Pad controls and audio feedback.

Practical Implications and Verification

For users looking to customize their smart TV interface, CleanFrame provides an alternative open-source option licensed under the MIT License. Running the software requires a device operating on Android 9.0 or newer with USB or Wi-Fi debugging enabled, alongside Android SDK tools for compilation and deployment.

To verify original details, instructions, and source files, interested developers and users can visit the official GitHub repository maintained by the project contributors.
